title: Multiflow
tagline: A dapp to manage and fund decentralized urban jobs from multiple participants.
description:
Multiflow facilitates the execution and verification of Urban Governance Projects by managing funds from voters supporting the project and distribute them between users who complete the required works to get the accumulated income. 

This project uses the proposals stored in the VoTARO governance contract to create decentralized works that can be funded by proposal voters or city stakeholders. The payout is transferred and divided between the workers after get validated of completion by voters.
how_its_made:
This project uses solidity contracts to manage the multiple flows and implements Gas Station Network  Base Paymaster contracts to allow gas-less interactions for workers. 



We fetch approved governances proposals from VoTARO a city DAO deployed in Ropsten Network to create the match between voters and workers.
